problem:
If
    $Z=[\begin{aligned}-8 & 2 & 10\end{aligned}]$,
then find the transpose of $Z.$

|  |  | {{field-1}} |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${Z}^{T}=\,\,$ |  | {{field-2}} |  |
|  |  | {{field-3}} |  |

examples.knowledge_point: Finding the Transpose of a Row Vector or Column Vector
examples.worked_solution:
To find the transpose, we interchange the rows and columns. 

Here, there is just a single row, so it becomes a single column:

$$
{A}^T = 
    		\left\lbrack
    		\matrix {
    5 \ 
    -1 \ 
    0 \  
    		}
    		\right\rbrack
$$

feedback.problem:
If
    $C=[\begin{aligned}6 & -1 & 0 \\ 4 & 3 & 8\end{aligned}]$,
then find the transpose of $C.$

|  |  | {{field-1}} | {{field-2}} |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${C}^{T}=\,\,$ |  | {{field-3}} | {{field-4}} |  |
|  |  | {{field-5}} | {{field-6}} |  |
feedback.worked_solution:
To find the transpose, we interchange the rows and columns:

$$
{C}^{T}=[\begin{aligned}6 & 4 \\ -1 & 3 \\ 0 & 8\end{aligned}]
$$
